response_property_constraints.description: The Response field must be one of the enumerated string values 'True' or 'False'.
The Poster field, when not 'N/A', must be a valid URI starting with http:// or https://.
The Type field, when present and not 'N/A', must be one of the values: 'movie', 'series', or 'episode'.
The imdbID field, when present and not 'N/A', must match the IMDb ID format starting with 'tt' followed by digits.
Each item in the Ratings array must have a 'Source' string and a 'Value' string.
The seriesID field, when present and not 'N/A', must match the IMDb ID format starting with 'tt' followed by digits.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'i' (a valid IMDb ID) is provided, the response's imdbID field must equal the value of 'i'.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: A valid IMDb ID (e.g. tt0000001)

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'type' is provided, the response's Type field must equal that value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Return movie, series or episode

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'y' (year of release) is provided, the response's Year field must contain or match that year value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Year of release

response_property_constraints.description: The 'type' field of each item in the data array must equal 'hotel-offers'.
The hotelId must match the pattern of exactly 8 uppercase alphanumeric characters (^[A-Z0-9]{8}$).
The chainCode must be exactly 2 uppercase letters (^[A-Z]{2}$).
The brandCode, when present, must be exactly 2 uppercase letters (^[A-Z]{2}$).
The cityCode must be exactly 3 uppercase letters (^[A-Z]{3}$).
The offer id must consist only of uppercase letters and digits, with a length between 2 and 100 characters (^[A-Z0-9]*$, minLength 2, maxLength 100).
The checkInDate must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
The checkOutDate must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format and must be strictly after checkInDate.
The rateCode must be exactly 3 characters matching the pattern ^[A-Z0-9*]{3}$.
The rateFamilyEstimated code must match the pattern [A-Z0-9]{3} (exactly 3 uppercase alphanumeric characters).
The rateFamilyEstimated type must match the pattern [PNC] (one of P, N, or C).

The boardType, when present, must be one of the enumerated values: ROOM_ONLY, BREAKFAST, HALF_BOARD, FULL_BOARD, ALL_INCLUSIVE, BUFFET_BREAKFAST, CARIBBEAN_BREAKFAST, CONTINENTAL_BREAKFAST, ENGLISH_BREAKFAST, FULL_BREAKFAST, DINNER_BED_AND_BREAKFAST, LUNCH, DINNER, FAMILY_PLAN, AS_BROCHURED, SELF_CATERING, BERMUDA, AMERICAN, FAMILY_AMERICAN, MODIFIED.
The paymentType must be one of the enumerated values: GUARANTEE, DEPOSIT, PREPAY, HOLDTIME, guarantee, deposit, prepay, holdtime.
The room type code must match the pattern ^[A-Z0-9*]{3}$ (exactly 3 uppercase alphanumeric or asterisk characters), or be 'ROH'.
The number of adult guests per room must be between 1 and 9 inclusive.
Each child age in the childAges array must be between 0 and 20 inclusive.
The cancellation policy type, when present, must be 'FULL_STAY'.
The cancellation policy percentage value, when present, must represent a number between 0 and 100.
The commission percentage, when present, must represent a number between 0 and 100.
The tax currency code, when present, must be between 1 and 3 characters in length.
Each entry in creditCards must be exactly 2 uppercase letters (^[A-Z]{2}$).
Each payment method in the methods array must be one of the enumerated Method values.
The self link of each offer, when present, must be a valid URI starting with http:// or https://.
The self link of each hotel-offers item, when present, must be a valid URI starting with http:// or https://.
The price variation startDate must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
The price variation endDate must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

request_response_constraints.description: Each hotel in the response data must have a hotelId that is present in the requested hotelIds parameter.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Amadeus property codes on 8 chars. Mandatory parameter for a search by predefined list of hotels.

request_response_constraints.description: When the 'adults' request parameter is provided, each offer's guests.adults value must equal that parameter.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Number of adult guests (1-9) per room.

request_response_constraints.description: When the 'checkInDate' request parameter is provided, each offer's checkInDate must equal that value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Check-in date of the stay (hotel local date). Format YYYY-MM-DD. The lowest accepted value is the present date (no dates in the past). If not present, the default value will be today's date in the GMT time zone.

request_response_constraints.description: When the 'checkOutDate' request parameter is provided, each offer's checkOutDate must equal that value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Check-out date of the stay (hotel local date). Format YYYY-MM-DD. The lowest accepted value is checkInDate+1. If not present, it will default to checkInDate +1.

request_response_constraints.description: When the 'roomQuantity' request parameter is provided, each offer's roomQuantity value must equal that parameter.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Number of rooms requested (1-9).

request_response_constraints.description: When the 'boardType' request parameter is provided, each offer's boardType must equal that value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Filter response based on available meals: ROOM_ONLY, BREAKFAST, HALF_BOARD, FULL_BOARD, ALL_INCLUSIVE.

response_property_constraints.description: The 'code' field must be an integer representing the HTTP status code of the returned result (e.g., 200 for success).
The 'offset' field in the data container must be a non-negative integer representing the number of skipped results.
The 'count' field must equal the number of items in the 'results' array.
The 'total' field must be a non-negative integer representing the total number of resources available.
The 'digitalId' field must be 0 if the comic is not available digitally, or a positive integer if it is.
The 'pageCount' field must be a non-negative integer representing the number of story pages in the comic.
The 'resourceURI' for the comic must be a valid URL starting with http:// or https://.
Each URL entry in 'urls' must have a 'url' field that is a full URL including scheme, domain, and path (starting with http:// or https://).
All prices in the 'prices' array must be in USD and must be non-negative numeric values.
The thumbnail 'path' must be a URL starting with http:// or https://.
The 'available' count in creators must be greater than or equal to the 'returned' count.
The 'returned' count in creators must equal the number of items in the creators 'items' array.
The 'available' count in characters must be greater than or equal to the 'returned' count.
The 'returned' count in characters must equal the number of items in the characters 'items' array.
The 'available' count in stories must be greater than or equal to the 'returned' count.
The 'returned' count in stories must equal the number of items in the stories 'items' array.
The 'available' count in events must be greater than or equal to the 'returned' count.
The 'returned' count in events must equal the number of items in the events 'items' array.
The 'collectionURI' in creators must be a URL starting with http:// or https://.
The 'language' field in TextObject must be an IETF language tag (e.g., 'en-us').
The 'resourceURI' in the series summary must be a URL starting with http:// or https://.

request_response_constraints.description: When the path parameter 'comicId' is provided, the 'id' field of the returned comic resource must match the requested comicId.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: A single comic.

response_property_constraints.description: The kind field of the response must be the fixed string 'youtube#videoListResponse'.
The kind field of each video item must be the fixed string 'youtube#video'.
The caption field in contentDetails must be one of the enumerated values: 'true' or 'false'.
The definition field in contentDetails must be one of the enumerated values: 'sd' or 'hd'.
The projection field in contentDetails must be one of the enumerated values: 'rectangular' or '360'.
The duration field in contentDetails must conform to the ISO 8601 duration format (e.g., PT#M#S, PT#H#M#S, P0D).
The resultsPerPage in pageInfo must be a non-negative integer and must equal the number of items returned in the response.
The totalResults in pageInfo must be a non-negative integer and must be greater than or equal to the number of items returned.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'maxResults' is provided, the number of items returned (resultsPerPage in pageInfo) should not exceed that value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The *maxResults* parameter specifies the maximum number of items that should be returned in the result set. *Note:* This parameter is supported for use in conjunction with the myRating and chart parameters, but it is not supported for use in conjunction with the id parameter.

The totalResults field, when present, must be a string that represents a non-negative integer.
The imdbID field in each Search item must conform to the IMDb ID format, starting with 'tt' followed by digits.
The Poster field in each Search item, when not 'N/A', must be a valid URL starting with 'http://' or 'https://'.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'type' is provided, every item in the Search array must have a Type equal to that value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Return movie or series

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'y' is provided, every item in the Search array must have a Year matching that release year.

response_property_constraints.description: The 'type' field must equal 'playlist'.
The 'uri' field must be a Spotify URI for a playlist, starting with 'spotify:playlist:'.
The 'href' field must be a valid URL starting with 'https://' providing full details of the playlist.
The 'external_urls.spotify' field, when present, must be a valid URL starting with 'https://'.
The 'followers.total' field must be a non-negative integer (total number of followers).
The owner's 'type' field must equal 'user'.
The owner's 'uri' field must be a Spotify URI for a user, starting with 'spotify:user:'.
The owner's 'href' field must be a valid URL starting with 'https://'.
The tracks page 'href' field must be a valid URL starting with 'https://'.
The tracks page 'total' field must be a non-negative integer representing the total number of tracks.
The tracks page 'offset' field must be a non-negative integer.
The 'collaborative' field must be a boolean value (true if the owner allows other users to modify the playlist).
The 'public' field must be a boolean or null value indicating the playlist's public/private status.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request body includes a 'name' parameter, the created playlist's 'name' field must equal that value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The name to assign to the new playlist.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request body includes a 'description' parameter, the created playlist's 'description' field must equal that value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The description to assign to the new playlist.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request body includes a 'public' parameter, the created playlist's 'public' field must equal that boolean value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The public/private status to assign to the new playlist.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request body includes a 'collaborative' parameter, the created playlist's 'collaborative' field must equal that boolean value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Whether the playlist should be collaborative.

request_response_constraints.description: The 'owner.id' in the response must match the 'user_id' path parameter used to create the playlist.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The user's Spotify user ID.

businesses.name: House of Blues Boston- Music Venue

response_property_constraints.description: The rating of each business must be a number between 1 and 5 (inclusive).

The price field of each business, when present, must be one of the enumerated currency symbol strings: '$', '$$', '$$$', '$$$$', '£', '££', '£££', '££££', '€', '€€', '€€€', '€€€€', '¥', '¥¥', '¥¥¥', '¥¥¥¥'.
Each entry in a business's transactions array must be one of the enumerated values: 'pickup', 'delivery', or 'restaurant_reservation'.
The image_url field of each business, when present and non-empty, must be a valid URL starting with 'http://' or 'https://'.
The url field of each business, when present and non-empty, must be a valid URL starting with 'http://' or 'https://'.
The is_closed field of each business must be a boolean value (true or false).
The review_count field of each business, when present, must be a non-negative integer.
The number of businesses returned must not exceed the limit parameter maximum of 50.

request_response_constraints.description: When the 'limit' request parameter is provided, the number of businesses returned must not exceed that limit value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Maximum number of businesses to return (max 50).

request_response_constraints.description: When the 'open_now' request parameter is 'true', all returned businesses should have is_closed equal to false (i.e., they are currently open).
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Filter businesses that are open now.

response_property_constraints.description: The limit value in the response must be between 0 and 50 inclusive, as specified by the query parameter constraints.
The offset value in the response must be a non-negative integer (>= 0).
The total number of items available must be a non-negative integer.
The number of items returned must not exceed the limit value in the response.
The album_type field for each item must be one of 'album', 'single', or 'compilation'.
The type field for each album item must be 'album'.
The Spotify URI for each album must start with 'spotify:album:'.
The href field for each album item must be a valid URL starting with 'https://'.
Each entry in available_markets must be a 2-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (uppercase letters).
The image URL for each image in the images array must be a valid URL starting with 'https://'.
Each artist object inside an album's artists array must have a type field equal to 'artist'.
Each artist's URI in the artists array must start with 'spotify:artist:'.
The next field, when not null, must be a valid URL starting with 'https://'.
The previous field, when not null, must be a valid URL starting with 'https://'.
The top-level href field must be a valid URL starting with 'https://'.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'limit' is provided, the response 'limit' field must equal that value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The maximum number of items to return

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'offset' is provided, the response 'offset' field must equal that value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The index of the first item to return

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 'include_groups' is provided, every album item's album_group must be one of the specified group types.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Filter by album types
